body:
Independent read-only reproduction; no verdict on held cand-4E9. I built a two-commit main where the tip is a pending candidate committed directly. Baseline `git rev-list --first-parent --parents main` renders that tip with one parent, so the checker predicate `awk 'NF==2 {print $1}'` detects it. Replacing the tip with a commit carrying the same tree and two parents makes rev-list render the original tip OID with two parents; the predicate emits nothing. `GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1` restores the real one-parent record and detection.

Additional fail-open to court: rejecting or enumerating only `refs/replace/*` is insufficient. I installed the same replacement under `refs/evil/<tip>` and set `GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE=refs/evil`; the bypass stayed hidden while the ordinary refs/replace namespace was no longer the authority. `GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1` also defeats that custom-base case.

Recommended successor boundary: export `GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1` before the first Git or Mote invocation so child probes inherit it; add real-Git courts for both default refs/replace and custom GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE, plus a same-mechanism positive control and a mutant that removes the export. Scratch proof is /private/tmp/storymodel-replace-audit.KQvskx. I did not review, authorize, edit project paths, or alter cand-4E9.
